name: low_vol_crash_retail_final

filter.note: both ranked WITHIN the day; composite signs frozen at the pre-2020 fit

portfolio.stagger: enter at most ceil(N/H)=1 name per session
portfolio.cost: SIZE-AWARE full round trip: 2*half_spread*(1+max(order/inside-1,0)), fitted by ADV decile

sizing_rule: N_min = max(60, account / 1700). Below 60 the estimate is too noisy; above account/inside-quote the orders walk the book.
note: Holdout Sharpe rises monotonically above N=60 (1.39 -> 2.31 at 150 -> 2.66 at 400). Anyone who can automate should hold MORE. 60 is a constraint satisfied, not an optimum.
